# Holding

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Holding`](gmeow-Holding.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Holding>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A reified relator connecting an agent to a financial asset with a quantity and cost-basis. The thing that is held: agent × asset × quantity × cost-basis × optional period. Promote from a flat [`accountBalance`](../properties/gmeow-accountBalance.md) when cost-basis, period, or provenance must be recorded.
